name: actionlint
description: Lint GitHub Actions workflow files on edit via actionlint, surfacing findings as advisory context.

actionlint_enabled.title: Check workflows
actionlint_enabled.description: Turn the plugin's Claude Code hooks (the opt-in end-of-turn check and the session-start probe) on or off

actionlint_end_of_turn.title: Check workflows in uncommitted changes at turn end
actionlint_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit actionlint check over the workflow lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Off by default.
